scientific_integrity: The product rule and general 0-Rees commuting criterion/clique-number framework are prior work. The claim evaluated is the exact ordinary and maximal clique enumerators and explicit maximality criterion. Exhaustive finite tests do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts only nonzero Boolean-rank-one idempotents and their induced commuting graph, not the full binary relation monoid. An earlier or broader clique-enumerator formula may cover the case; publication priority is provisional. Independent proof and priority reviews are not performed.
title: Clique and maximal-clique enumerators for rank-one idempotent Boolean relations
